requirement.description: Incorrect handling of empty responses during group/user expansion in Nextcloud plugin
requirement.contract: The _get_group_users and _get_all_users methods should properly handle empty or invalid JSON responses from Nextcloud API. When API calls return empty or invalid responses, they should return None to indicate failure rather than proceeding with incorrect logic.

requirement.description: Fix NotifyType.INFO mismatch in error handling scenarios
requirement.contract: The _expand_targets method should consistently return appropriate notification responses when group/user expansion fails. The error handling logic should properly set the return value to False when expansion fails, rather than allowing mismatched return types.

requirement.description: Cache invalidation and retrieval issues in Nextcloud plugin
requirement.contract: The caching mechanism should properly handle cache expiration and retrieval. When targets are expanded, the cache should be properly checked and invalidated according to the configured expiration time.

requirement.description: Invalid email address handling in SendGrid plugin
requirement.contract: The plugin should properly validate email addresses during initialization. Invalid email addresses should cause a TypeError to be raised instead of allowing malformed notifications to proceed.

The plugin template verification in the API details function should properly map all template arguments to function parameters. All template tokens and arguments defined in the plugin templates must have corresponding parameters in the __init__ method signature.
